# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
Low volatility opening ranges often precede volatility expansion; a breakout with above-average volume captures the ensuing directional move. This edge exists because tight OR ranges indicate liquidity consolidation and indecision, and a volume-supported breakout signals institutional participation triggering follow-through.

## Mechanism
Entry: If today's opening range (OR_high - OR_low) is in the lowest 20% of the last 20 days' OR ranges AND price breaks above OR_high on a bar with volume > 1.5x the average volume of the first 5‑min bars, go long at the close of that breakout bar.  
Exit: Chart-stop at OR_low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1.5R, runner trail 15% off high‑water mark.  
Regime hint: Prefers VIX < 20 and time between 09:30‑10:30 EST; avoid days where OR range exceeds its 20‑day average (choppy conditions).
